title: Logo Contest
metaDescription: Help create Almondyoung's new logo. Submit your design and vote for your favorite.
headline:
Help create
Almondyoung's new logo
lead: Submit a logo and vote for your favorite. The entry with the most votes becomes Almondyoung's new logo.

help.votes: Shows the top 4 entries by votes, among entries with at least one vote.
help.tie: When votes are tied, the entry submitted first ranks higher.
help.refresh: While you're on this page, the ranking updates every 30 seconds.

periodBefore: You can submit a logo and vote from {start}. See you soon!

homeDescription: Vote for the logo you like
empty: No entries yet. Be the first to submit one.
